title: Provider Observation Store Operation Guard Contract

author_side_execution.reason: the automation runtime has repository mutation access but no executable exact private-repository checkout; source inspection and LLM review are not hard evidence

adversarial_corrections: the first contract draft bound target, execution and lease digests but did not mechanically require the target-relative path to be the sole writable path in both execution and Effect Lease scope; store_scope_path is now derived from target.path relative to attempt_root and compared exactly

the unrelated-scope builder test originally attempted to construct a schema-invalid request and would have failed before reaching the contract; it now mutates a frozen exact request through object.__setattr__ to exercise the contract's defense against validation bypass
remaining_blockers: the canonical effect entrypoint registry does not yet contain the initialize and bind-start operations
the central execution path must verify and begin the persisted Effect Lease before consuming this GuardDecision
the operation authority has no durable one-use consumption ledger
the pre-provisioned initializer and binding ledger are not yet invoked only through the guarded entrypoints
runtime manifest and RuntimeConformanceReceipt objects are represented only by bound digests in this preparatory contract
the complete SQLite open, begin, select, insert, commit, rollback and close fault matrix remains pending guarded integration
the historical auto-initializing ledger remains a production inventory blocker
GitHub Actions issue 67 prevents exact-head jobs from reaching Step 1
this packet does not issue OwnerApproval, PromotionReceipt, merge authority or a Gate transition
